 should carry the suitable safety category.

Maintenance staff should be well trained, qualified or 
 directly supervised by some one who is.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear the personal protective equipment must used as safety

sections.text:
Safety and healthy equipment as 
 safety harnesses, cotton suit,... etc

The following compression fittings are suitable for galvanised steel copperweld 
or alumoweld earthwires joints and dead ends are of stainless steel to UNI X 3 
CN 1911 standard corresponding to A I S I 304 L dead ends are drop forged and 
finished by machining joints are wholly made by machining dead ends can be of 
two types

Same recommendations given for aluminium compression fittings apply for assembly 
of these fittings
Bolted type Tension Clamps for Earth Wires

They are suitable for galvanized steel alumoweld or copperweld earth wires (with 
optional liners or pure aluminium or copper) body and keeper are made of 
galvanised drop forged steel tightening is assured by means of a variable number 
of bolts according to the clamp size

Following the diameter and composition of the earth wire they have a minimum 
slipping strength variable from 70 to 90 % of the earth wire rated breaking 
strength

Please note that for aluminium alu alloy or alu steel earth wires hexagonal 
compression dead ends or U - bolt type tension clamps 1600 A or B series can be 
used

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, 
which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Abd El-Satar, 
EEHC technical inspection & quality control head sector, and from TL 
instructions document, 
this document certified by by eng. MPIS 
zone coordinators
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff 
 should carry the suitable safety category.
Maintenance staff should be well trained, qualified or 
 directly supervised by some one who is.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear the personal protective equipment must used as safety 
 shoes, safety helmet, earplug, and gloves pairs...etc
Tools and 
Equipment
Safety and healthy equipment as 
 safety harnesses, cotton suit,... etc
Work to be Carried out
The following compression fittings are suitable for galvanised steel copperweld 
or alumoweld earthwires joints and dead ends are of stainless steel to UNI X 3 
CN 1911 standard corresponding to A I S I 304 L dead ends are drop forged and 
finished by machining joints are wholly made by machining dead ends can be of 
two types
With long eye terminal
With tongue terminal
With long eye terminal
With tongue terminal
Same recommendations given for aluminium compression fittings apply for assembly 
of these fittings
Bolted type Tension Clamps for Earth Wires
They are suitable for galvanized steel alumoweld or copperweld earth wires (with 
optional liners or pure aluminium or copper) body and keeper are made of 
galvanised drop forged steel tightening is assured by means of a variable number 
of bolts according to the clamp size
Following the diameter and composition of the earth wire they have a minimum 
slipping strength variable from 70 to 90 % of the earth wire rated breaking 
strength
Please note that for aluminium alu alloy or alu steel earth wires hexagonal 
compression dead ends or U - bolt type tension clamps 1600 A or B series can be 
used
